newsitem.title: UK: UK Nursing Home pays 17 mln stg for 8 homes.
newsitem.headline: UK Nursing Home pays 17 mln stg for 8 homes.

text.p: Britain's Nursing Home Properties Plc said on Tuesday it was acquiring eight nursing homes for 17.06 million stg.
NHP is the country's first property investment group to specialise in purchase and leaseback of purpose-built care homes.
The acquisitions comprise a total number of 478 beds and this expands Nursing Home's portfolio to 69 nursing and residential homes with 4,016 beds.
The group's chief executive Richard Ellert said the demand for sale and leaseback of care homes continued to rise and NHP would be on the lookout for further acquisitions.
